# Keep CPU reads of image memory below 0xc0000000

CPU reads of the 0xc4000000 frame block rebooted the camera.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

0xc0000000 to 0xc2aa0000 is ARM Linux RAM. Read frames above it through the image engine, not the CPU.

> **What happens:** Camera reboot.

**Symptoms:** [Restarts or crashes when a feature runs](index.md#restart-in-use)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): An E-M5 III build that read the 0xc4000000 block with the CPU rebooted. Source: [Gotchas](../sources/em5n.gotchas.md).
